description: A previously agreed deadline and owner change. These must be extracted as decisions carrying the NEW value, so memory can raise a conflict against the stored one.
transcript:
Anita: Quick update on the launch plan.
Rohit: Go ahead.
Anita: The investor pitch is now due the day after tomorrow, not Friday.
Rohit: Understood. And Priya is taking over the compliance forms instead of me.
Anita: Right. I'll update the tracker today.

expected_items.quote: The investor pitch is now due the day after tomorrow, not Friday.
expected_items.note: A changed deadline is a decision, not discussion. due_raw must be the NEW date. Owner is 'unknown': the sentence names nobody and contains no 'we'/'let's', so per the OWNER RULE inventing 'group' would be wrong.

expected_items.quote: Priya is taking over the compliance forms instead of me.
expected_items.note: A changed owner is also a decision. Memory should conflict this against any stored owner.
Control case: an ordinary commitment in the same conversation.

must_not_extract: the OLD Friday deadline as if it were still current
anything classified as 'discussion' - a change is a decision
